learning_levels.L0: VPC is a private cloud network boundary.
learning_levels.L1: VPC contains subnets and AWS resources.
learning_levels.L2: VPC design includes IP addressing, subnets, routing, and gateways.
learning_levels.L3: VPC supports production workload segmentation and connectivity.
learning_levels.L4: VPC architecture requires route tables, endpoint, gateway, and security design.
